title: Four Levels of Training Evaluation
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A four-step staircase of reaction, learning, behavior, and results, with the illustrative evidence for a workshop of 20 teachers at each step.

educational.topic: The four levels of training evaluation and the evidence that belongs at each
learningObjectives: The learner will place a piece of workshop evidence at the right level of training evaluation and explain why a happy survey is not enough.
prerequisites: Training evaluation from [Chapter 19](../../chapters/19-training-certifying-reviewers/index.md) and the cautions of Chapters 16 and 17.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Which level does this evidence measure?
What would stronger evidence look like?
commonMisconceptions: A happy exit survey shows the training worked
assessmentOpportunities: "17 of 20 teachers earned the certificate" belongs to which level?
"9 components were reused by another teacher" belongs to which level?
Why is a count of reuse weaker than evidence of learning?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
